page.layout: One printed page, single column of centred dedication text with a woodcut ornament band at the top; no margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: VIRO Magnifico, Præstrenuo ac Præ-Nobilissimo DN. JOHANNI VULTEJO, JCto; Serenissimæ Domûs Hasso-Cassellanæ Consiliario intimo; atque Cancellario Gravissimo; Susceptori è sacro baptismatis fonte ac Patrono meo humilimè colendo, instarque Patris venerando

p.i: Hoc solenne Gymnasma in studiorum meorum commendationem inscribo ac offero

page.notes: The ornament band at the top is a printer's woodcut, not text. The signature line "JOHANNES LOMBARDUS," is set in small capitals with "Respondens." below it. Background show-through from the reverse side is ignored.
